E1.prediction: The written gated block raises the held-out AUC to at least 0.75. Medium (its gate opened on 56% of fit imitations, which caps the gain).

E2.prediction: The written block leaves at least 95% of ESC-50 fold 4 and 5 non-chicken clips bit-identical, and changes per-class accuracy on folds 4 and 5 by at most 1 clip in every class. Medium.

E3.prediction: The trained layer reaches a held-out AUC of at least 0.85. Medium.

E4.prediction: The trained layer changes per-class accuracy on folds 4 and 5 by more than 1 clip in at least one class. Low-medium.

E5.prediction: The steering arm, scaled on the fit split to the written block's fit AUC, changes more fold 4 and 5 classes' accuracy than the written block does. Medium.

E6.prediction: Controls gain less than 0.05 held-out AUC each: the written block with a random direction, the written block gated by two random same-layer neurons, and the trained layer fitted on shuffled real/imitation labels. High.
